purpose: Company journey S0 replay: sign in, open a workspace, list companies, write one company, read it back, and attempt unauthorized access.

company.name: Journey Fixture Co
company.note: The values are repeated in both drivers and in this file. No script reads this file, so a change must be made in all three places.

twentyBaseline: seeded demo member of the Apple workspace
convexCandidate: outsider with a separate workspace, created by sign-up

twentyBaseline.signInMethod: email and password through getLoginTokenFromCredentials then getAuthTokensFromLoginToken

services.lifetime: created for the capture and removed with their volume afterwards

seedCompanies.derivation: sha256 of the lines 'name|domainNamePrimaryLinkUrl', one per company excluding the fixture company, ordered by name then line
seedCompanies.artifact: not retained; recorded from the capture session's query output

featureFlags.scope: identical in the Apple and YCombinator workspaces
featureFlags.artifact: not retained; recorded from the capture session's query output

twentyBaseline.multiWorkspaceMode: off (IS_MULTIWORKSPACE_ENABLED is commented out in .env.example, so the default applies)
twentyBaseline.runtime: Node v26.10.0 although package.json declares ^24.5.0 and .nvmrc says 24.16.0

convexCandidate.runtime: convex-test in-process backend with the real registered functions and the real @convex-dev/auth signIn action
convexCandidate.signInMethod: preview-password provider: signUp with allowlisted email and invite code, then signIn with email and password
convexCandidate.generatedPerRun: RSA signing key pair created with Web Crypto; nothing is stored
convexCandidate.data: empty database created per test run
convexCandidate.deployedPreview: not exercised; needs deployment credentials and preview allowlist values that this environment does not hold

locale: en for both sides; the candidate preview sets its interface language to 'en' with empty catalogs
providerMode: none: no email, calendar, billing or other external provider was connected on either side

flags.FENFORCE_PREVIEW_AUTH_ENABLED: true for signUp only inside the test process; default false in .env.schema
flags.REACT_APP_FENFORCE_CONVEX_URL: unset renders the original Twenty app; set renders the Convex preview

proposed: generated identifiers compared by role, not value
timestamps compared by presence, not value
normalization.applied: none: every compared value was a fixed string, a count or a presence flag
